items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I used to rehearse with him. He called me up and would go up to his house and we'd sit on it.

ctx.x: Yeah, we never think much about Danny Barker, he's been gone so many years. Do you remember when he played around here?

Yeah, he stood here quite a while. I used to rehearse with him. He called me up and would go up to his house and we'd sit on it. He had two six-string banjos. He promised me one I didn't pick up on at the time, so he gave it away to someone else. He's a wonderful banjo musician too. I saw him in New York in 59. I spent a couple days with him at his house.
Did you ever hear Johnny St. Sarah much in the old days?
